geometry.active_rule: Q1 cell with any chi > 0 vertex; its entire nodal closure is material-inverted.
geometry.seam_rule: Closed active and fully melted native Q1 cells meeting across a face, edge or vertex.
geometry.adjacency: Closed cell hit plus one full native Chebyshev layer (sharing a face, edge or vertex).
geometry.precedence: Primary C=(fold OR seam) before B=weld. Individual masks retain all overlaps.
geometry.fold_scope: Cells intersecting the whole mapped image of a prism with nonpositive determinant somewhere.
geometry.weld_scope: Image of the original shared core/collar material surface under the saved physical placement.
geometry.bit_code: weld + 2*fold + 4*seam, all with one neighbor layer
